name: Posterizarr (Dev)
description: Local asset metadata provider and real-time WebSocket sync engine. Instantly maps and updates posters, backgrounds, seasons, and title cards without library scans.
overview: A companion plugin for Posterizarr that maps local assets to Jellyfin library items and connects to Posterizarr's real-time WebSocket stream (/ws/events) to instantaneously apply rendered artwork in under a second.
